S.FORM: == kaliliman == micidekay kusuday atu kikay wawa怪博士與機器娃娃 micidekay kusuday atu kikay a wawa "kamu nu Lipwud, Dr.スランプ,kamu nu Ing Dr. Slump" Cong-Kow tal aimi "Y-la -lye" Syang-kang" a imi "IQ kusuday" Cong-kow talu a kamu "satinengay a kusuday atu kikay a wawa niza" nu Zipun a mangga Nyaw-san-min 1980 a mihcaan a nisulita a bangga. zumaay a mangga nu Nyaw-san-min "Ci-lung-cu"a misaigi itini tu a banggaan a tahkal, u Ci-lung-cu" angangan a miigiay ci sun-u-kungpatelac a micumud tu ci-e a niyazu' miculek tahkal paazih. i inaka a niyazu' "taduk a niyazu'', singanganay u sitinengay a ce-cye-cyen misebengay hitay a sukuday, maydih misanga' tu malecaday tademaw a kikay tademaw, kabahalan misannga' tu caay ku nizatengan a ce-cyen-a-la-lye, musakamu tu pacebaay a kungkku namakayza malingatu. nisumadan musaungayay bangga i tilibi nu tung-ing a nisanga'an musaungayay bangga. Saayaway a nisanga'an i 1981 a mihca 4 a bulad 8 a demiad katukuh 1986 a mihca 2 a bulad 19 a demiad i bu-se tilibi patahkal paazih "Zipun a tuki tulu a demiad tu paylipay 19:3019:00" Taywan ku situngusa patahkal u min-se-u-syen-tay, hwa-se,wi-se-cong-win-tay,tung-sen tilibi hatini ku mialaay a tilibi, Syeng situngusay patahkal u Syang-kang-u-syen tilibi ku mialaay, nu Syang-kangay angangan a dadiw ci Mey-yen-hang ku mudadiway, 2009 a mihca 7 a bulad 17 a demiad J2 muliyaw patahkal. 1997 a mihcaan muliyaw patahkal tu niliyawan a nisanga'an a cudad, pabelin han u "baluhay micidekay a kusuday atu kikay wawa" pangangnan han tu "baluhay·kikay wawa micidekay kusuday", katuud ku wayway nu miigiay nanisumad tu, Syang-kangay, yu-syen tilibi adiwawaay a tilibi i ayaw tu 2003 a mihcaan saayaway patahkal tuyni a nisanga'an, angangan a dadiw ci U-tan-zu ku mudadiway, u-syen tilibi i 2014 a mihcaan kya micakay tuyni nisanga'an caay paacai a situngus patahkal I tilibi, I 2014 a mihca 4 a bulad 23 a demiad malingatu patahkal paazih. 1997 . malalitin tu i hekalay atu zumaay a natinengan
